method: Ran the locked showcase set (model01-v1: p1-p5, chat mode, seed 7, temp 0.7, top-p 0.9, max 64, maxToolRounds 0) against model01/sft.onnx and model01/dpo.onnx, and the pretrain continuation set in next-word mode (max 96), with the exact production sampler (mulberry32, onnxruntime-web WASM).

sft.p1: opens 'Dear Adrienne, I hope this message finds you well...' (email-form letter, on-intent)
sft.p2: stays on exercise/health ('recommended exercise for health is a healthy lifestyle... active, maintain a healthy weight')
sft.p3: clean one-line greeting, ends reason=end: 'Dear All, I hope you're well... excited to be a friend.'
sft.p4: answers 'The capital city of Japan is Tokyo, with a capital of around 2,000,000 inhabitants.' (correct)
sft.p5: drifts toward 'bees as a fundamental concept in mathematics' (only weak prompt, still English)
sft.verdict: 4/5 on-topic; email form + correct facts; Everyday English intent reads correctly

dpo.p1: collapses to 'Dear, dear, dear friend, dear friend...' loop
dpo.p2: near-topic ('In short, exercise is a crucial component of maintaining good health')
dpo.p3: drifts off to 'Dear King, ... glad you're enjoying your music'
dpo.p5: near-topic ('bee as a fundamental aspect of honey production')
dpo.verdict: 3/5; p1/p3 framing is off; no better than SFT

pretrain.p4: degenerate loop: 'The capital city of Japan is located in Tokyo.' repeated ~10x
pretrain.verdict: next-word mode loops; not a clean showcase

reason: SFT is the only stage that stays in an English-writing frame across the set (email p1, greeting p3, correct Tokyo p4). DPO regresses to loops (p1) and off-topic drift (p3); pretrain next-word loops badly on p4/p5. Follows the model04/07/08 precedent of presenting SFT when DPO regresses or is no better.
note: Supersedes the catalog's previous PENDING/null stage.
